mentions.name: Contributions to PostgreSQL
mentions.description: An effort to contribute meaningfully to the PostgreSQL open-source database project. The contributor is asking PostgreSQL users to share the problems they face, big or small, via an Ask HN post to guide their contributions and growth as a Postgres hacker.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am aiming to contribute meaningfully to the postgres project, to learn and grow as a Postgres hacker, I want to hear directly from you—PostgreSQL users—about the problems you face, big or small.
